title: 21 Business Ideas for 2026 (Part 1/4)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Get my 12 favorite biz ideas for 2026, with full launch plans included here: https://tkopod.co/youtubeD

I've started 72+ businesses. This is me talking about #1 - 21, in no particular order. I've started over 70 businesses, so this is part 1 of me talking about all of them. 

Hopefully this helps you generate some ideas of your own. Or shoot, copy these yourself! 

Almost all of them would still work today. Enjoy! I'd love your follow and review, but only if I've earned it.
